note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on every name, description and grade). 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned. All 55 are offline, single-player trophies. Guides are written in our own words for this entry and cite their sources; nothing is copied from another guide.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you will earn. It unlocks automatically once the other 54 are done — there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap below and it pops when the final one does.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, early in Chapter 1. Just play the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Awarded for finishing Chapter 1 — keep playing the main missions and it comes on its own.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Awarded for finishing Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Awarded for finishing Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Awarded for finishing Chapter 4.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Awarded for finishing the final story mission. After the credits you can keep exploring Leonida in free roam, so nothing is locked behind the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Awarded for finishing the mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Awarded for finishing the mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Awarded for finishing the mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Awarded for finishing the mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Awarded for finishing the mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Awarded for finishing the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set. Reach 100% completion — a 35-task checklist that only opens up after the story, tracked in-game at Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion. Most of the work is the collectibles and counts in stages 3 to 6 of this roadmap. Expect around 200 hours for the Platinum as a whole.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses and air time in vehicles all count toward the total. Stunts are the long grind of this list, so chip away at them whenever you are driving between objectives.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once — shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, hunting, bowling, meditation and the rest. You do not need to win or finish anything, just start each type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There is no shortcut: work through every challenge and repeat the ones you miss until each shows gold. Track your medals at the range itself.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own race; winning each once is enough.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeat wins on the same race do not count, so spread your wins across 20 distinct events.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and win the head-to-head challenge against him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play any arcade cabinet through to its end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side-content trophy. Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand — follow Andy's missions as they appear around Leonida until his strand ends.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side-content trophy. Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side-content trophy. Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The five named strangers in this guide (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) cover five strands — find three more stranger strands in the world to reach eight.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side-content trophy. Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side-content trophy. Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the only trophy reported as possibly missable — do not skip Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1, and meditate at each spot as you find it rather than leaving them for later.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take the hunting contract from Bret and track down the specific animal he names — it is a one-off hunt, not regular wildlife.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect full sets of each and the trophy unlocks at the third completed set.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. The in-game app lets you tag spots as you visit them — keep tagging new places as you travel and the count climbs.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small objectives listed in the game's Progress menu — work through them alongside everything else and the total adds up.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build up a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Bring your partner, commit crimes until four stars show, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies down.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, keep the wanted level alive between them, and do not get caught or killed in between.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles you drive for the first time count toward the total — borrow, steal or buy different models as you come across them.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with a group of enemies close together and clear five of them before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — get a plane moving at Vice City International Airport and take off without following the usual departure routine.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description points at the Rhino tank. Get into a Rhino and use it — the exact trigger is not yet documented by any guide, so try the tank in combat and check back if it does not pop.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm — and get out with the goods before anyone notices.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vault robberies are the big heists of the open world — hit five different vaults and get away clean each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, take its cargo and lose the cops.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named area of the map — the trophy tracks the regions you have set foot in, so sweep the corners you would otherwise never visit.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs illegal operations somewhere in Leonida — hit one per gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — a quiet moment, not a mission.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle straight through a showroom's glass front — the exact showroom is not yet documented, so try the big dealerships.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the bowling alley and play a frame — the trophy is about showing up and bowling, not a high score.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description gives nothing away — 'a partnership with mass appeal'. No guide has confirmed the unlock yet, so treat it as unconfirmed and check back once players pin it down.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description points at story choices — 'choices made (for better or worse)'. One choice is known to be permanent: the Irredeemable criminal profile, so think before you pick it. The exact trigger is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' — the method is unconfirmed. It likely involves failing something once and succeeding on the retry, but no guide has confirmed it yet.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No guide has confirmed how this one unlocks — the game only shows a hint. Do not rely on unverified methods; check back once players confirm it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. The precise setup is still being confirmed by guides, so expect this one to need a few attempts.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the total is cumulative.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. It is cumulative across every shop in the game — clothes, food, weapons and more all count.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buying every garage costs about $160,000 in total and adds 8 vehicle storage slots.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register vehicles you own through the app until ten are listed.
